definition: to make a process simpler and faster

definition: a small test of a new idea before a company uses it everywhere

definition: to make a job happen by machine, without people doing it

definition: something that puts your company ahead of the others

definition: a step in a process where work slows down because too much arrives

definition: the support and agreement of the people who have to accept a change

definition: to start using a new idea or tool
